incompatibleRuntime.title: Bu sistem paketlenmiş backend tarafından desteklenmiyor
incompatibleRuntime.description: evaOS Workbench açıldı, ancak yerel managed runtime backend bu Linux sürümünde çalışamaz. Desteklenen bir Linux dağıtımına yükseltip evaOS Workbench'yi yeniden başlatın.

incompleteInstallation.title: evaOS Workbench kurulumu eksik
incompleteInstallation.description: Bu kurulumda gerekli yerel kaynaklar eksik, bu yüzden managed runtime başlatılamıyor. Lütfen en son evaOS Workbench sürümünü indirip yeniden kurun. Yeniden kurulumdan sonra sorun tekrarlarsa güvenlik veya antivirüs yazılımının managed runtime'u karantinaya alıp almadığını kontrol edin.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: evaOS Workbench package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This evaOS Workbench package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data needs repair
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: evaOS Workbench detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. With your confirmation, evaOS Workbench will ask the managed runtime to back up the old database and create a new local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics or cancelling will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.cancelHint: No database changes were made. Restart evaOS Workbench when you are ready to try recovery.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up and rebuild the database
